description: This file defines the SortArray class with static methods for sorting arrays by various keys such as 'weight', '#weight', 'title', and '#title'. It includes recursive sorting and comparison functions tailored for structured arrays in Drupal.

classes.name: SortArray
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for sorting arrays based on different keys and properties, including recursive sorting.

methods.name: sortByWeightElement
methods.description: Sorts an array of associative arrays by the 'weight' element.

methods.name: sortByWeightProperty
methods.description: Sorts an array of associative arrays by the '#weight' property.

methods.name: sortByTitleElement
methods.description: Sorts an array of associative arrays by the 'title' key.

methods.name: sortByTitleProperty
methods.description: Sorts an array of associative arrays by the '#title' key.

methods.name: sortByKeyString
methods.description: Compares two array elements by a specified string key using natural case-insensitive comparison.

methods.name: sortByKeyInt
methods.description: Compares two array elements by a specified integer key.

methods.name: sortByKeyRecursive
methods.description: Recursively sorts an array by keys, sorting nested arrays as well.
